in_sanskrit.name: तिमिर
in_sanskrit.meaning: dark, deep, dense, night, obscure, shadow, unknown
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Timir is derived from the Sanskrit word तिमिर (timir), which means 'dark, deep, dense, night, obscure, shadow, unknown'. This word is used to describe anything that is not visible or not known, such as the darkness of night or the unknown depths of the ocean. It can also be used metaphorically to describe someone who is mysterious or enigmatic.

in_hindi.name: तिमिर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Timir in Hindi is written as तिमिर (timir). Its meaning is 'temir' or 'atigarbh'. Temir means 'dark, deep, dense, night, obscure, shadow, unknown'. Atigarbh means 'beyond the body, beyond the physical form'. So, the name Timir in Hindi can be interpreted as 'the unknown beyond the physical form' or 'the deep, dark mystery of existence'.

in_tamil.name: திமிர
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Timir in Tamil is written as திமிர (timir). Its meanings are 'thiruvinsam' (a divine gift), 'malar' (lotus), 'malai' (mountain), and 'kovai' (fort, citadel). The name Timir in Tamil can be interpreted as 'the divine gift of the dark, deep, dense, night, obscure, shadow, unknown' or 'the mountain of the lotus of the unknown'.

in_telugu.name: తిమిర
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Timir in Telugu is written as తిమిర (timir). Its meanings are 'dobhej' (dark, deep, dense) and 'dobhejeswara' (the lord of the deep, dark, dense). The name Timir in Telugu can be interpreted as 'the lord of the deep, dark, dense mystery' or 'the deep, dark, dense enigma'.
